name: Patterson River mouth / ramp channel
notes: Launch point; training walls, 5-knot speed limit inside river, shoals on bar in onshore (SW/S) wind >15 kn - avoid in wind-against-tide conditions. Coordinates are approximate river mouth.

name: Carrum weed & sand beds
notes: Easy reachable whiting and flathead ground off Carrum; weed patches hold calamari. Stay clear of swimming zone buoys inshore.

name: Aspendale/Edithvale shallows
notes: Flathead and whiting over sand; sandbar edges. Watch for swimmers and weed at low tide.

name: Mordialloc offshore shallows
notes: Sand and weed edges; pinkie snapper in summer; snapper in spring. Mordialloc creek mouth has shoals.

name: Frankston reef & Pier area
notes: Famous snapper area; artificial reef ~40 m off pier head attracts snapper, trevally, leatherjackets, salmon and calamari. Stay clear of the pier and anglers.

name: Olivers Hill / Frankston-Mt Eliza deeper ground
notes: Reef and deeper mud/sand patches - prime spring-summer snapper ground.

name: Canadian Bay (Mt Eliza)
notes: Sandy bay with weed; calamari and whiting; good protected swim stop in settled conditions.

name: Mornington snapper grounds (16-24 m)
notes: Well known spring-summer snapper area with reef and drop-offs; also gummy shark at night. Coordinates approximate - verify on chart.

name: Mornington harbour & pier
notes: Calamari, pinkie, whiting, garfish around pier and harbour entrance; public jetty and marina. Watch for ferry/commercial traffic.

name: Mount Martha shallows & Fishermans Beach
notes: Weed beds; whiting, calamari and garfish; good snapper deeper out. Boat access ok in calm seas.

name: Safety Beach / Dromana weed beds
notes: Sandy-weed flats for whiting and calamari; shallow ramp areas. Watch boat speed limits near the shore.

name: Rosebud offshore flats
notes: Large sand/weed flats; whiting, flathead; calamari. Good on a calm day as a long run - fuel check required.

name: Chinaman's Hat seal colony
notes: Navigation marker off Portsea that Australian fur seals haul out on. Idle past slowly and keep your distance — Victorian rules set minimum approach distances for seals (check the current distance on wildlife.vic.gov.au); no feeding, no swimming with them. Long run (~25 nm) — calm days only; right next to the South Channel shipping lane.

name: Sorrento/southern bay dolphin area
notes: Bottlenose dolphins common around Sorrento-Queenscliff. Boats must stay >=100 m from dolphins; 200 m from whales; do not chase or encircle. Southern bay run only in calm weather. Coordinates approximate - verify on chart.

name: Mud Islands (birds)
notes: Seabird and wader colonies; part of Port Phillip Heads Marine National Park/Ramsar area. Breeding birds - landing restricted; keep distance. Coordinates approximate.

name: Popes Eye (snorkel/gannets)
notes: Marine park with gannets; snorkel in calm conditions; no fishing. Very far for a 6.1 m boat in exposed channel; only on very calm days.

name: Ricketts Point snorkel & marine sanctuary
notes: Marine sanctuary: no fishing, no collection. Snorkel trail close to shore on a calm day. Boundaries approximate.

name: Mount Martha beaches swim anchorage
notes: Calm shallow sandy bays for a dip; anchor in sand, not weed. Check speed limit & swim zones.

name: Safety Beach swim anchorage
notes: Shallow sandy flats; good for a dip; watch kite/windsurf traffic.

name: Rosebud flats swim spot
notes: Wide shallow sand flats; calm; ideal in light northerlies.

name: Canadian Bay swim spot
notes: Protected shallow bay; good for lunch break;

name: Mornington Harbour (lunch)
notes: Pier & marina; short walk to Main St cafes/restaurants. Public jetty has time-limited berthing; check Mornington pier rules.

name: Mordialloc Creek (lunch)
notes: Creek mouth restaurants and fish & chips; mooring at public jetty subject to availability. Entrance can be shallow.

name: Patterson River marina/restaurants (lunch)
notes: River-side restaurants and marina at Carrum; easy home-base lunch stop.

name: Sorrento (lunch)
notes: Sorrento pier/hotel/cafes; temporary mooring subject to space. Far - needs calm day.

name: Jawbone Marine Sanctuary
notes: No fishing zone in western bay (outside eastern focus). Boundaries approximate.

name: Point Cooke Marine Sanctuary
notes: No fishing zone in the western bay near Point Cooke.

name: Port Phillip Heads Marine National Park (Mud Islands section)
notes: No fishing zone: Mud Islands area. Boundaries approximate - check Parks Victoria map.

name: Frankston Pier swimming & exclusion buoys
notes: Pier swimmers and anglers; keep clear. Boating restricted by buoys near shore.

name: Carrum swimming zone / 5-knot zone
notes: Beach swim zones and 5 kn speed limits near shore and river mouth. Watch buoys & signs.

name: Patterson River bar (onshore wind)
notes: Breaking waves/steep shoals across the bar in S/SW onshore winds; plan return before wind change. Coordinates approximate - verify on chart.

name: South Channel shipping lane
notes: Ships transit; keep clear, do not anchor in channel. Larger ships need space to stop - cross promptly.

name: The Rip / Port Phillip Heads
notes: Extremely dangerous tidal race; do not enter with a 6.1 m trailer boat.
